description: Self-eval conversations. Test ids are namespaced at runtime so this never collides with real data. Two users (alice, bob) across multiple sessions exercise fact evolution, implicit facts, and cross-user isolation.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Alice. I work at Stripe as a backend engineer.
Nice to meet you, Alice! How's life at Stripe?
I live in San Francisco. I have a dog named Biscuit.
Biscuit is a great name for a dog!
By the way, I'm vegetarian and I'm allergic to shellfish.
Got it, I'll keep your dietary needs in mind.
I spent today debugging a React performance issue with too many re-renders in our analytics dashboard.
Excessive re-renders are a common React pitfall.
Quick update: I just started at Notion as a product manager.
Congratulations on the new role at Notion!
Also, I moved to Berlin from San Francisco last month.
Berlin is a wonderful city to live in.
Hey, I'm Bob. I work at Google and I love TypeScript.
Hi Bob, nice to meet you!
